en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a huge public celebration in a European city square by a canal. A very large flag dominates the foreground, with crowds filling the square and lining the waterfront. In the background is a classical building with a tall clock tower. There are many smaller flags, soldiers in formation, and a statue in the middle of the square. Printed captions in Swedish identify the location and publisher.
